about: Shared local efforts: a finding on the map that people take forward together, linked to related work, organizations and the governments that might act. 'example' marks a sample made by Threadlands to preview the page: nobody proposed it and nobody has been contacted. An effort stays 'proposed' until a person or organization has actually taken responsibility for its next step.

fields.responsible: who has taken responsibility for the next step, only once they have agreed: {name, kind: organization|person|office, since}
fields.next: the next step, who does it and by when
fields.jurisdictions: governments whose area covers the effort: possible, not contacted, until a step says otherwise
fields.record: dated public record; private correspondence and unconsented photos are never published

efforts.title: Shade and water in eastern Iztapalapa
efforts.ask: More street trees and shade, and a public drinking-water point, in one of the hottest, least green parts of eastern Iztapalapa.

next.text: A person or organization takes responsibility for the next step: walking the area with the people who raised it and choosing the first stretch to work on.
